steps.title: Levels of Kai Training
paragraphs: You begin your adventure as an Initiate of the Kai. As you survive each mission, your training will grow and your rank will rise.
The Kai path is long: novice, acolyte, initiate, guardian, savant, and beyond. Every book is a step toward greater mastery.

steps.title: Kai Disciplines
paragraphs: Choose five Kai Disciplines before the story begins. These skills shape how you survive the road ahead.
You can select, review, and change your choices during this setup phase before entering the first playable section.

steps.title: Select Your Five Kai Disciplines
paragraphs: Pick exactly five skills. The app will carry them into the adventure and use them during checks and story choices.

options.label: Camouflage
options.description: Blend into your surroundings and move unseen.

options.label: Hunting
options.description: Find food and move stealthily in the wild.

options.label: Sixth Sense
options.description: Feel danger or hidden intent before it strikes.

options.label: Tracking
options.description: Read tracks and choose the correct route.

options.label: Healing
options.description: Recover endurance between moments of combat.

options.label: Weaponskill
options.description: Master a weapon and strike more effectively.

options.label: Mindblast
options.description: Attack with the force of your mind.

options.label: Mind Over Matter
options.description: Move small objects with focused concentration.

steps.title: Begin the Adventure
paragraphs: Your Kai training is set. The monastery lies in ruins, and the journey to Holmgard begins now.
